title: Load test — Live
description: One screen for the night: the audience's path from the radio to the show app, each stage with its own row. ennemi-infra docs/load-test-observability.md.

panels.title: Funnel: the path of a phone, left to right. The first tile to go red says which stage to look at
Clients on Wi-Fi
panels.description: Stations associated, all APs and radios (UniFi API).

panels.title: DHCP /min: DISCOVER vs ACK
panels.description: From the gateway's dnsmasq-dhcp log lines. ACK far below DISCOVER: phones asking again and again.

panels.title: DHCP NAK + no address /min
panels.description: Any value is bad: a NAK sends the phone back to DISCOVER; 'no address available' means the pool is out.

panels.title: Public leases / pool
panels.description: Active leases on the audience network against the size of its pool (UniFi API).

panels.title: DNS q/s, upstream failures
panels.description: ennemi-brain's dnsmasq: cache hits + misses per second, and forwarded queries that failed.

panels.title: App sockets
panels.description: WebSockets open on ennemi-webapp, by domain (user = phones).

panels.title: Audience count
panels.description: Phones the show app counts as present.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx + 499 /min
panels.description: Server errors and clients that gave up (499), from nginx's JSON access log.

panels.title: Radio, per AP (UniFi API through unpoller, 30 s)
Clients per radio
panels.description: More than ~60 on one radio while another is idle: placement or steering.

panels.title: Channel utilisation (total)
panels.description: Airtime busy as the AP hears it, our own traffic and the neighbours' included.

panels.title: Transmit retry rate

targets.expr: sum by (name, band) (rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_retries_total[2m])) / sum by (name, band) (rate(unpoller_device_vap_transmit_packets_total[2m]))

panels.description: Retried frames over transmitted frames per radio, from the VAP counters. Above 30 %: interference or clients too far.

panels.title: Average client signal per VAP
panels.description: Below -75 dBm on average: the phones on that radio are far, or steered to the wrong band.

panels.title: Channel per radio (a colour change is a DFS move)
Join quality, from the APs' own logs (stahtd station tracker, hostapd)
Join events /min by type, all APs
panels.description: association -> success is the happy path; failure, soft failure and deny are phones that did not get on.

panels.title: Time to an IP, p95 per AP (ip_delta, raw units: confirm against a known join)

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="unifi", app="stahtd", event_type="success"} | regexp `"ip_delta": "(?P<ip_delta>-?\d+)"` | unwrap ip_delta [5m]) by (device)

panels.description: The station tracker's ip_delta on successful joins. Looks like microseconds; check before trusting the scale.

panels.title: DNS timeouts seen by the APs /min
Gateway dnsmasq exits

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="unifi", kind="gateway"} |= "process exit event for process dnsmasq" [1m]))

panels.description: The gateway's DHCP server restarting mid-show, as on 2026-11-04 at 20:57.

panels.title: dnsmasq cache /s
panels.description: Evictions above zero: the cache (10000 entries) is too small.

panels.title: dnsmasq 'maximum concurrent queries reached' /min

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({unit="dnsmasq"} |= "Maximum number of concurrent DNS queries" [1m]))

panels.description: dns-forward-max (2000) reached: queries dropped.

panels.title: Server: nginx, the host, the show app

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="nginx-access", route!="websocket"} | json | unwrap request_time [1m]) by (route)

panels.title: App event-loop lag and memory
panels.description: Lag idles at ~20 ms (the sampler's resolution). Above 100 ms the app is falling behind.

panels.title: Socket events /min
panels.description: socket-closed:no-pong and rejoin rising together: phones dropping off the Wi-Fi.

panels.title: Switch and gateway port errors + drops /s
panels.description: Only ports with a non-zero rate are drawn.
